cards.body: Fishwife tinned mussels are here 🎉!!! Meet our newest tin: Mussels in Basil Pesto. This tin was made for pasta night, picnic spreads with toothpicks for plucking, or straight from the tin with a crusty baguette. It's packed with plump mussels, fresh, herbaceous pesto, and evokes the flavors of a European summer in every bite.
